text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—A race run carrying all the cheers from 
Mifuyu-chan and the others. I gave it 
every last ounce of my strength! (I was so 
relieved that I couldn't help but laugh!)"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"After the race, I made a promise with 
Mifuyu-chan. I'll get results in my races, 
and she'll get results on the ice, so next 
time we meet, we can hold our heads high!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"My next goal is the Oka Sho! It's finally 
time to take on the Tiara route!"
